text.title: django-api Procedure
text.summary: Nine-step procedure: layer audit → framework → endpoints → serializers → service signatures → auth → throttle → schema + error shape → validate.

step.name: layer-audit
step.action: Grep views for ORM writes, external API calls and multi-step transactions. Move each hit to `<app>/services.py` (business logic) or `<app>/integrations/` (third-party calls) before the spec is written.
step.decision-gate: If a view body still exceeds ~25 lines after the move, it still holds logic — do not proceed.

step.name: pick-framework
step.input: Project context: greenfield vs existing DRF / Ninja, async needs.
step.action: Pick framework="drf" for ecosystem + complex perms; "ninja" for async-first + Pydantic. Lock it.
step.decision-gate: If the codebase already uses one, do NOT switch; choose the same.

step.name: enumerate-endpoints
step.action: For each resource: pick kind (model-viewset / apiview / ninja-router-crud / ninja-router-action), methods, pagination strategy.

step.name: declare-serializer-pair
step.action: For each endpoint, declare distinct input_serializer (Create or Update) and output_serializer (Detail or List). Never the same class for both.

step.name: fix-service-signatures
step.action: Replace `def fn(request, ...)` with `def fn(*, user_id: int, ...)` taking domain types. The view passes `request.user.id` and `serializer.validated_data` fields explicitly.
step.decision-gate: Grep for `request` inside `services.py`; any hit blocks. Rule r9-service-takes-domain-types.

step.name: wire-auth
step.action: Set auth.mode + access_ttl_minutes ≤ 15 + refresh_ttl_days ≤ 7 + rotate_refresh=true + blacklist_after_rotation=true + transport.

step.name: declare-throttle-and-pagination
step.action: Set throttle.scopes to include anon, user, burst, login. Per endpoint, pick pagination=cursor (unbounded list) or page-number (counted list) or none (single resource).

step.name: generate-openapi
step.action: DRF: install drf-spectacular, set SPECTACULAR_SETTINGS, decorate each ViewSet/action with `@extend_schema`. Ninja: rely on the built-in schema. Wire `templates/check-api-schema.sh` into CI so a breaking diff fails the build.
step.output: openapi.{generator, ci_drift_check} + a generated schema file.

step.name: wire-error-shape
step.action: Point `REST_FRAMEWORK["EXCEPTION_HANDLER"]` at one handler that renders every raised exception as RFC 7807 `{type, title, status, detail, instance}`. Re-test all 4xx responses against that shape.
step.decision-gate: Any endpoint returning a bespoke error body blocks. Rule r11-error-shape-rfc7807.
